# spytial-gdl

> A small graph description language for live, draggable diagrams with explicit spatial requirements.

Create graph diagrams or translate Mermaid flowcharts and Graphviz DOT graphs, then embed them in
Markdown or HTML. Point an agent or workflow at the skill for task guidance
and links to the relevant authoring, integration, and validation references.

## Start here

- Agent skill: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/SKILL.md
- Operations skill: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/skills/spytial-operations/SKILL.md
- Selectors skill: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/skills/spytial-selectors/SKILL.md
- GDL language manifest: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/spytial-gdl-language.json
- Core layout manifest: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/spytial-core@^6.3.0/docs/spytial-language.json
- Selector language manifest: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-graph-query@3/docs/sgq-language.json
- Introduction: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/pages/introduction.md
- Notation: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/pages/notation.md
- Annotations: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/pages/annotations.md
- Embedding and API: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/pages/embedding.md
- Platform recipes: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/docs/pages/platforms.md
- Playground: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/playground/
- Examples: https://www.siddharthaprasad.com/spytial-gdl/examples/
- Source: https://github.com/sidprasad/spytial-gdl

## Minimal integration

Add this script to the page that renders Markdown:

    <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/spytial-gdl/src/auto.js"></script>

Then use fenced blocks with the `spytial-gdl` language identifier. SKILL.md
routes agents to the guidance needed for their task.
